description: Derived extractions for the PowerShell channels (winlog.channel == 'Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' or 'Windows PowerShell'). These events classify as process activity; the script content (ScriptBlockText for 4104, HostApplication/CommandLine for the classic log) is left in winlog.data.* where it is already searchable, since ECS has no dedicated PowerShell field. event.category/type only.

script.source: def id = ctx.winlog.event_id; def M = ['4103':['process',null],'4104':['process',null],'400':['process','start'],'403':['process','end'],'600':['process',null],'800':['process',null]]; def e = M.get(id); if (e != null) { if (!(ctx.event instanceof Map)) { ctx.event = [:]; } if (e[0] != null && ctx.event.category == null) { ctx.event.category = e[0]; } if (e[1] != null && ctx.event.type == null) { ctx.event.type = e[1]; } }
